module: Data provider for the pause menu "traffic controls" panel. It counts traffic vehicles (driving, parked, police, active/inactive) via gameplay_traffic, gameplay_parking and gameplay_police, computes the quantities to spawn from the settings (trafficAmount, trafficExtraAmount, trafficParkingAmount, trafficParkedVehicles) and builds the buttons (start, stop, delete, spawn normal traffic, police or parked vehicles, enable/disable). The buttons are executed by executeTrafficControlAction.
notes: The buttons are created once (buttonModule) then cloned on each getData call, with disabled and, for the spawn buttons, spawnAmount {total, traffic, activeTraffic, extraTraffic, normalTraffic, police, parked}.

The planned police quantity is 25% (rounded up) of the active traffic; "active" traffic is trafficAmount, or getMaxVehicleAmount(10) if the setting is 0 (then adjusted by gameplay_traffic.getIdealSpawnAmount).
If police vehicles are not listed by gameplay_police, traffic vehicles whose Config Type is "police" (or whose .pc contains "police") are counted instead.
Traffic is considered enabled if at least one vehicle exists and the traffic state is "on" or parking is active.
During the "traffic" lesson of the first drive, the returned state is forced to "off" as long as no traffic or parked vehicle exists.
Labels are translated with _tr (ui.radialmenu2.traffic.*), except the "toggleTraffic" button whose "Traffic" label is hard-coded.

getData.desc: Builds the traffic panel state: traffic state, parking active, enabled, canActivateExisting (more than one object in the scene), driving/parked/police/total counters ({total, active, inactive}) and action buttons (toggle, controls, spawn).

payload.desc: requestId is returned as is; editable == false disables all buttons.

returns.desc: {requestId, state, parkingActive, enabled, canActivateExisting, driving, parked, police, total, actions}.

executeTrafficControlAction.desc: Executes a button's action by its identifier: start, stop or delete traffic, spawn normal, police or parked traffic, or toggle.

payload.desc: Data passed to the button's callback.

returns.desc: false if buttonId is nil, otherwise the callback result.
